messages:
Rita (Marketing): brainstorming abstracts + social hooks for next webinar. want to land something punchy for devs and platform teams. quick thoughts?
Dan (Events): we should have a short one-line blurb + 2-paragraph abstract for site + a 30s social clip script
Priya (Content): proposed headline: 'Serving LLMs: predictable latency, lower cost, fewer surprises'
Priya (Content): abstract draft: 'Join Redwood engineers and customers to see how modern serving patterns reduce per-token cost while keeping latency tight. Well demo routing, failovers, and cost controls that matter in production.'
Leo (Product): love the angle. add a line about deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private) so infra teams know it's relevant
Hannah (Sales): audience ask: can we include callouts for enterprise procurement and compliance? helps sales qualify early
Marta (Creative): for promo creative, need 3 headline lengths: banner (8-10 words), tweet (1 sentence), linkedin (2 lines). I'll mock by EOD
Rita (Marketing): CTA options: demo request, join waitlist for dedicated capacity, download benchmark. which should be primary?
Hannah (Sales): Primary: demo request (hot leads). Secondary: benchmark download (mid-funnel). Tertiary: waitlist (for large accounts)
Priya (Content): social script idea (30s): "See how we keep inference predictable across clouds. Live demo + customer story. Register now."
Dan (Events): rehearsal plan: full run Mon 15:00 UTC. green room 15 min before. clip harvest: mark timestamps for 0-60s, 60-180s, hero moment (customer quote)
Marta (Creative): clip-bot can auto-create 30/60s cuts if we provide timecodes. we need captions & lower-thirds for speakers.
clip-bot: tip: include speaker exact quotes in the doc to help ASR.
Leo (Product): for demo prompts, I'll send 4 reproducible prompts + expected outputs. prefer short inputs to control timing
Priya (Content): speaker bios needed. @Leo can you write a 40-word bio + one-line role call by Fri?
Leo (Product): yep. sending tonight.
Hannah (Sales): lead routing: registration form fields -> use_case dropdown + budget range + urgency radio. route rules:
Hannah (Sales): - budget >= 50k -> AE followup
Hannah (Sales): - POC request -> Solutions Eng
Hannah (Sales): - small trial -> SDR nurture
Rita (Marketing): we also want utm + session_id to stitch webinar attendees to site visits. add hidden field to reg form
Dan (Events): recording consent checkbox must be explicit. legal provided copy: "I consent to recording and future use of clips"
Priya (Content): follow-up cadence: email 0: immediate thank you + calendar + resources; email 1 (24h): short highlights + benchmark; email 2 (3 days): clip and CTA to schedule demo
Marta (Creative): will prepare 4 social cards (announce, 2 reminders, last chance). need speaker photos + headshots
Rita (Marketing): can we get a short quote from the customer for the promo? Kira is our customer speaker, @Hannah can you check?
Hannah (Sales): I'll ping Kira and ask for a 1-2 sentence blurb we can use.
Dan (Events): risk plan: if live demo fails, fallback to recorded demo + live Q&A. if internet blips, move Q&A earlier and shorten demo
Leo (Product): note: test model key limits during rehearsal. throttling caused a hiccup last month.
Rita (Marketing): action items: Priya - finalize abstract + social copy; Marta - creative assets; Dan - rehearsal scheduling + clip workflow; Hannah - customer blurb + routing rules; Leo - demo prompts & bio
Priya (Content): will upload drafts to the shared drive and tag everyone.
Rita (Marketing): thanks all. aiming to publish registration page Wed AM. :rocket:
